Notes

  • Photos shown are real JAGG photos from the job gallery and the recent family set. Each post runs 10; five are shown here, with the rest behind the count — the same way Facebook displays them.

  • Post 1's photos are placeholders from the library. The real set is the Wantagh job, which was shot start to finish and has the matching before and after.
  • The December 15 date is what gives the offer urgency. It needs to be a date JAGG will actually hold to.
  • Post 2 cites the JAGG Insurance Advantage and the 90-day and 1-year follow-ups — JAGG's own published language. Worth confirming it is still accurate.
